Affine algebraic group

Words: 643 Articles: 21
Lie theory OurBigBook.com
An affine algebraic group is an affine variety G whose multiplication and inversion are regular maps. Equivalently, its coordinate ring k[G] is a commutative Hopf algebra, with comultiplication induced by multiplication in G.

Lie algebra of an affine algebraic group

Words: 31
Affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
The Lie algebra of an affine algebraic group G is the tangent space Te​G at its identity. Its bracket is the commutator of the corresponding left-invariant derivations of the coordinate ring.

Descent of an irreducible SL2 representation to PGL2

Words: 33
Affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
The irreducible rational representations of SL2​(C) are Symn(C2). Such a representation descends through SL2​→PGL2​ exactly when the central element −I acts trivially, which holds exactly when n is even.

Faithful representation of an affine algebraic group

Words: 46
Affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
Every affine algebraic group has a faithful finite-dimensional rational group representation. Choose algebra generators of k[G] and place them in a finite-dimensional subspace stable under right translations. An element acting trivially on that subspace has the same coordinate values as the identity and therefore is the identity.

Left-right regular representation of an affine algebraic group

Words: 39
Affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
The group G×G acts on k[G] by
((a,b)f)(x)=f(a−1xb).
(1)
For G=Gm​, this gives k[G]=⨁r∈Z​k(−r,r)​. For G=Ga​, the action factors through (a,b)↦b−a and the degree filtration of k[t] has trivial one-dimensional successive quotients.

Semisimple element of an affine algebraic group

Words: 24
Affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
An element of an affine algebraic group is semisimple when its image in one, equivalently every, faithful finite-dimensional representation is a diagonalizable linear map.

Unipotent element of an affine algebraic group

Words: 25
Affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
An element of an affine algebraic group is unipotent when its image in one, equivalently every, faithful finite-dimensional representation has every eigenvalue equal to one.

Jordan decomposition in an affine algebraic group

Words: 32
Affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
Every element g of an affine algebraic group has unique commuting semisimple and unipotent parts gs​,gu​ such that g=gs​gu​. The construction agrees with the multiplicative Jordan decomposition in every rational representation.

Derived subgroup of an affine algebraic group

Words: 97 Articles: 2
Affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
The derived subgroup [G,G] is the closed algebraic subgroup generated by the commutators xyx−1y−1. If G is connected, images of finite products of commutators are connected and their closures stabilize by dimension, which shows that [G,G] is connected.

Solvable affine algebraic group

Words: 58 Articles: 1
Derived subgroup of an affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
An affine algebraic group is solvable when its derived series reaches the identity. A connected solvable affine algebraic group can be conjugated into an upper triangular matrix group by the Lie-Kolchin theorem.
Lie-Kolchin theorem
Words: 27
Solvable affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
Every connected solvable affine algebraic subgroup of GL(V) preserves a complete flag in V, equivalently it is conjugate to a subgroup of the upper triangular matrices.

Unipotent algebraic group

Words: 55 Articles: 1
Affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
A unipotent algebraic group is an affine algebraic group all of whose elements are unipotent. The Kolchin theorem embeds it into an upper unitriangular group.

Kolchin theorem

Words: 32
Unipotent algebraic group OurBigBook.com
Every unipotent algebraic subgroup of GLn​ is conjugate to a subgroup of the upper unitriangular group. The filtration by vanishing initial superdiagonals then proves that every unipotent algebraic group is a nilpotent group.

Diagonalizable algebraic group

Words: 30
Affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
A diagonalizable algebraic group is isomorphic to a closed subgroup of a product of copies of Gm​. Every rational representation of such a group decomposes into weight spaces.

Reductive algebraic group

Words: 153 Articles: 6
Affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
A reductive algebraic group is a smooth connected affine algebraic group whose largest connected normal unipotent algebraic group is trivial.

Borel subgroup

Words: 78 Articles: 3
Reductive algebraic group OurBigBook.com
A Borel subgroup is a maximal closed connected solvable subgroup of an affine algebraic group.
Parabolic subgroup
Words: 37 Articles: 1
Borel subgroup OurBigBook.com
A parabolic subgroup of a connected reductive group is a closed subgroup containing a Borel subgroup. Its quotient in the group is projective.
Levi subgroup
Words: 15
Parabolic subgroup OurBigBook.com
A Levi subgroup is a reductive complement to the unipotent radical of a parabolic subgroup.
Flag variety of an algebraic group
Words: 26
Borel subgroup OurBigBook.com
For a connected reductive algebraic group G and a Borel subgroup B, the quotient G/B is its complete flag variety. Quotients G/P by parabolic subgroups are partial flag varieties.

Root datum

Words: 33
Reductive algebraic group OurBigBook.com
A root datum is a quadruple (X∗,Φ,X∗​,Φ∨) of dual lattices, roots, and coroots with the natural perfect pairing and reflection axioms. A reductive group with maximal torus T has X∗=X∗(T) and X∗​=X∗​(T).

Bruhat decomposition of a reductive algebraic group

Words: 25
Reductive algebraic group OurBigBook.com
For a connected reductive algebraic group, a Borel subgroup B, and a maximal torus T⊆B, the Weyl group W=NG​(T)/T indexes the double cosets:
G=⨆w∈W​Bw˙B.
(2)

Algebraic-group torsor

Words: 50
Affine algebraic group OurBigBook.com
For an algebraic group H, a flat H-torsor over Y is a faithfully flat morphism X→Y with a right H-action such that X×H→X×Y​X, (x,h)↦(x,xh), is an isomorphism. A Zariski torsor additionally becomes U×H on a Zariski open cover of Y.

Lie group

Words: 690 Articles: 26
Lie theory OurBigBook.com
A Lie group is a group that is also a smooth manifold, with smooth multiplication and inversion. Its tangent space at the identity carries a natural Lie algebra structure.

Lie group action

Words: 27
Lie group OurBigBook.com
A Lie group action is a smooth group action of a Lie group on a smooth manifold. Differentiating the action gives an infinitesimal action of its Lie algebra by vector fields.

Matrix Lie group

Words: 124 Articles: 2
Lie group OurBigBook.com
A matrix Lie group is a subgroup of a general linear group that is also a Lie group for its matrix topology. Near the identity, the matrix exponential and matrix logarithm give inverse coordinate charts whenever they are restricted to sufficiently small neighborhoods in the group and its tangent space.

Exponential map of a matrix Lie group (exp:g→G)

Words: 41
Matrix Lie group OurBigBook.com
For a Matrix Lie group G with Lie algebra g, its exponential map is the restriction of the matrix exponential, X↦eX. It maps g into G and is a local diffeomorphism at zero, but it need not be surjective globally.

Logarithmic chart of a matrix Lie group

Words: 42
Matrix Lie group OurBigBook.com
For a matrix Lie group G with Lie algebra g=TI​G, choose neighborhoods on which exp:g→G and log:G→g are inverse. Left translation gives a chart near g∈G by
h⟼log(g−1h).
(3)
The Baker--Campbell--Hausdorff formula expresses multiplication smoothly in these coordinates.

Simple Lie group

Words: 32
Lie group OurBigBook.com
A connected Lie group is simple when its Lie algebra is nonabelian and simple. Some conventions additionally quotient out or exclude a discrete center; the infinitesimal gauge fields depend only on the Lie algebra.

Homogeneous space

Words: 31
Lie group OurBigBook.com
A homogeneous space is a space on which a group acts transitively. After choosing a point, a transitive Lie-group action identifies the space with a quotient G/H by the point stabilizer.

Left and right translation on a Lie group (Lg​,Rg​)

Words: 117 Articles: 4
Lie group OurBigBook.com
For a Lie group G, left and right translation are the diffeomorphisms Lg​(h)=gh and Rg​(h)=hg. They commute: Lg​Rh​=Rh​Lg​.

Left-invariant vector field (lξ​)

Words: 22
Left and right translation on a Lie group OurBigBook.com
For ξ in the Lie algebra of G, the left-invariant vector field is lξ​(g)=(dLg​)e​ξ. Its global flow is right translation Φt=Rexp(tξ)​.

Left-invariant differential form

Words: 77 Articles: 2
Left and right translation on a Lie group OurBigBook.com
A differential form α on a Lie group is left-invariant when Lg∗​α=α for every g. It is determined by its value at the identity.
Bi-invariant differential form
Words: 54 Articles: 1
Left-invariant differential form OurBigBook.com
A differential form on a Lie group is bi-invariant when it is invariant under both left and right translations.
Closed left-invariant 1-form
Words: 37
Bi-invariant differential form OurBigBook.com
On a connected Lie group, a left-invariant differential 1-form is closed exactly when it is bi-invariant. Connectedness is essential: on O(2) every left-invariant 1-form is closed because its Lie algebra is abelian, while reflection conjugation negates every nonzero one.

One-parameter subgroup

Words: 34
Lie group OurBigBook.com
A one-parameter subgroup of a Lie group G is a smooth homomorphism γ:(R,+)→G. Every such subgroup has the form γ(t)=exp(tX) for a unique X in the Lie algebra of G.

Circle group (S1)

Words: 20
Lie group OurBigBook.com
The circle group is the unit complex numbers under multiplication, equivalently planar rotations or the quotient R/(2πZ).

Lie-group representation

Words: 27 Articles: 1
Lie group OurBigBook.com
A Lie-group representation is a smooth group representation D:G→GL(V).

Derived representation

Words: 18
Lie-group representation OurBigBook.com
The derived representation of a smooth Lie-group representation is dD(X)=dtd​​0​D(exp(tX)). It is a Lie algebra representation because dD([X,Y])=[dD(X),dD(Y)].

Adjoint representation of a Lie group (Ad)

Words: 59 Articles: 1
Lie group OurBigBook.com
The adjoint representation of a Lie group is its action on its Lie algebra by differentiating conjugation. For a matrix Lie group, Adg​X=gXg−1.

Adjoint double cover from SU(2) to SO(3) (SU(2)→SO(3))

Words: 35
Adjoint representation of a Lie group OurBigBook.com
Conjugation by SU(2) on its three-dimensional real Lie algebra of traceless skew-Hermitian matrices preserves −tr(AB) and defines a surjection
SU(2)⟶SO(3)
(4)
with kernel {±I2​}. It is the universal double covering of SO(3).

Local group law

Words: 30
Lie group OurBigBook.com
A local group law is the coordinate expression z=F(y,x) of multiplication near the identity of a Lie group. The identity, inverse, and associativity equations for F encode the group structure locally.

Maurer-Cartan form

Words: 45 Articles: 2
Lie group OurBigBook.com
For a matrix Lie group, the left-invariant Maurer-Cartan form is ρ=g−1dg. It identifies each tangent space with the Lie algebra and obeys dρ+ρ∧ρ=0.

Maurer-Cartan equation

Words: 20 Articles: 1
Maurer-Cartan form OurBigBook.com
The Maurer-Cartan equation is dρ+ρ∧ρ=0 for the left-invariant form ρ=g−1dg.

Real affine group

Words: 14
Lie group OurBigBook.com
The orientation-preserving real affine group acts by x↦eax+b and has multiplication (a,b)(a′,b′)=(a+a′,b+eab′).

Left-invariant metric

Words: 45 Articles: 1
Lie group OurBigBook.com
A left-invariant Riemannian metric is preserved by every left translation. Its Killing fields generated by left translations are right-invariant vector fields.

Geodesic-vector criterion for a left-invariant metric (⟨ξ,[ξ,η]⟩=0)

Words: 24
Left-invariant metric OurBigBook.com
For a left-invariant metric on a Lie group, the one-parameter subgroup γξ​(t)=exp(tξ) is a geodesic exactly when
⟨ξ,[ξ,η]⟩=0
(6)
for every η in the Lie algebra. The Koszul formula gives ⟨∇ξ​ξ,η⟩=−⟨ξ,[ξ,η]⟩.

Exponential map of a Lie group (exp:g→G)

Words: 29
Lie group OurBigBook.com
For a matrix Lie group, the exponential map is the matrix exponential expX=∑n≥0​Xn/n! and sends one-parameter additive subgroups of the Lie algebra to one-parameter subgroups of the group.

Cayley transform (Lie theory, C(X)=(I+X)(I−X)−1)

Words: 31
Lie group OurBigBook.com
The Cayley transform is a rational local parametrization of a matrix Lie group from its Lie algebra wherever I−X is invertible. Unlike the exponential map, its image can meet nonidentity components.

Lie algebra

Words: 4k Articles: 184
Lie theory OurBigBook.com
A Lie algebra over a field is a vector space g with a bilinear operation [x,y], called the Lie bracket, that is alternating and satisfies the Jacobi identity.

Lie algebra generator

Words: 37
Lie algebra OurBigBook.com
A Lie algebra generator is an element of a chosen spanning or generating set for a Lie algebra. In a matrix representation, an infinitesimal group transformation has the form 1+iαa​ta+O(α2) in terms of generator matrices ta.

Lie algebra of a matrix Lie group

Words: 49
Lie algebra OurBigBook.com
For a Matrix Lie group G, its tangent space g=TI​G is closed under the matrix commutator. Indeed, for X,Y∈g, the group commutator
etXesYe−tXe−sY
(7)
lies in G, and the mixed derivative at (0,0) of its matrix logarithm is XY−YX. Thus [X,Y]=XY−YX belongs to g.

Lie algebra isomorphism

Words: 19
Lie algebra OurBigBook.com
A Lie algebra isomorphism is a bijective linear map φ:g→h satisfying φ([x,y])=[φ(x),φ(y)]. Its inverse automatically preserves the Lie bracket.

Direct sum of Lie algebras

Words: 17
Lie algebra OurBigBook.com
The direct sum g⊕h has componentwise bracket
[(x,y),(x′,y′)]=([x,x′],[y,y′]).
(8)
The two summands are commuting ideals.

Lie subalgebra

Words: 33 Articles: 1
Lie algebra OurBigBook.com
A Lie subalgebra is a vector subspace closed under the Lie bracket.

The signed symmetric group consists of permutations of {±1,…,±n} commuting with sign change. It is the Coxeter group of type Bn​.
Even signed symmetric group (ESSn​)
Words: 28
Signed symmetric group OurBigBook.com
The even signed symmetric group is the index-two subgroup of signed permutations with an even number of sign changes. It is the Coxeter group of type Dn​.

Affine Coxeter group

Words: 13
Coxeter group OurBigBook.com
An irreducible affine Coxeter group has a positive-semidefinite Coxeter Gram matrix with a one-dimensional radical.

Hyperbolic Coxeter group

Words: 15
Coxeter group OurBigBook.com
A hyperbolic Coxeter group has a nondegenerate Coxeter Gram matrix of Lorentzian signature in its standard geometric realization.

BN-pair

Words: 53 Articles: 1
Coxeter group OurBigBook.com
A BN-pair in a group G consists of subgroups B,N such that G=⟨B,N⟩, H=B∩N is normal in N, and W=N/H has distinguished involutory generators satisfying the Bruhat multiplication axioms. The quotient W is its Weyl group.

Bruhat decomposition of a BN-pair

BN-pair OurBigBook.com
The Bruhat decomposition is the disjoint union
G=⨆w∈W​Bw˙B
(69)
associated with a BN-pair.

Hecke algebra

Words: 144 Articles: 4
Coxeter group OurBigBook.com
A Hecke algebra is a deformation of the group algebra of a Coxeter group, obtained by deforming the quadratic relations for its simple generators while retaining the braid relations.

Generic Hecke algebra of a Coxeter system (Hgen​(W,{ai​}))

Words: 53 Articles: 1
Hecke algebra OurBigBook.com
Over the polynomial parameter ring, the generic Hecke algebra has basis (Tw​)w∈W​ and multiplication
Ti​Tw​={Txi​w​,ai​Txi​w​+(ai​−1)Tw​,​ℓ(xi​w)>ℓ(w),ℓ(xi​w)<ℓ(w).​
(70)
The parameters must agree for conjugate simple generators; equivalently, (Ti​−ai​)(Ti​+1)=0 together with the braid relations presents the algebra.
0-Hecke algebra
Words: 15
Generic Hecke algebra of a Coxeter system OurBigBook.com
The 0-Hecke algebra is the specialization ai​=0 of a Generic Hecke algebra of a Coxeter system. Its generators obey Ti2​=−Ti​.

Iwahori-Hecke algebra of a BN-pair (Hk​(G,B))

Words: 65 Articles: 1
Hecke algebra OurBigBook.com
For a finite group G with a BN-pair, the Iwahori-Hecke algebra over k is the endomorphism algebra of the permutation module k[G/B], up to the conventional opposite algebra. Its standard basis is indexed by the Bruhat double cosets.
Hecke parameter of a BN-pair (qi​)
Words: 25
Iwahori-Hecke algebra of a BN-pair OurBigBook.com
For a representative x˙i​∈N, the Hecke parameter is
qi​=[B:B∩x˙i​Bx˙i−1​].
(71)
The Iwahori-Hecke algebra of a BN-pair is obtained from the generic algebra by ai​↦qi​⋅1k​.
